sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
-> Pair it with tops, shirts, dresses, kurtis, or co-ord sets to add a cute and meaningful touch without overdoing the look.

-> The twin-heart design already has shine and detail, so you can wear it solo for a clean, polished style.

-> Avoid direct contact with perfume, water, sweat, or harsh chemicals.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 You know those little things you pick without overthinking, but they instantly feel like “your type”?
The Twin Hearts Pendant has that kind of charm. 💛

It is not trying to look serious or heavy. It feels cute, polished, and easy to wear — the kind of pendant that adds personality to even a simple outfit. One heart keeps the design soft and clean, while the second heart brings that bright sparkle. Together, they make the piece feel playful, balanced, and full of affection. ✨

The twin-heart design gives the pendant a sweet and stylish personality, making it perfect for everyday fashion, casual plans, date looks, brunch outfits, festive styling, or gifting. It adds a soft aesthetic touch without making the look feel too much.

Finished with 24K gold tone plating, the pendant has a rich golden shine that looks premium, elegant, and fashionable without feeling loud. It comes with the VELORE Snake Chain – 24K Gold Tone Plated, adding a smooth, sleek, and ready-to-wear finish to the neckline.

Designed with a skin-friendly feel and a polished premium coating, this pendant is comfortable to wear and easy to style with different outfits.

Wear Twin Hearts on days when you want your jewellery to feel sweet, effortless, aesthetic, and a little personal.
Not too much. Not too plain. Just the right amount of love and shine. 💫

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. What is the Twin Hearts Pendant designed to represent?

The Twin Hearts Pendant represents love, connection, affection, and the sweet bond you share with yourself or someone special.

2. Does this pendant come with a chain?

Yes, it comes with the VELORE Snake Chain – 24K Gold Tone Plated, giving it a sleek, smooth, and ready-to-wear finish.

3. What is the plating of the pendant?

The pendant is 24K Gold Tone Plated, which gives it a rich golden shine and premium look.

4. Is the Twin Hearts Pendant skin-friendly?

Yes, it is designed to feel comfortable and skin-friendly for regular wear.

5. Can I wear the Twin Hearts Pendant daily?

Yes, you can wear it daily with casual, festive, office, or date looks. Just avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain the shine for longer.

6. Is this pendant good for gifting?

Yes, it makes a beautiful gift for birthdays, anniversaries, friendships, self-love gifting, or someone who enjoys cute and stylish jewellery.

7. How should I style this pendant?

You can wear it solo for a cute statement look or layer it with a thin gold-tone chain for a more styled appearance.

8. What makes this pendant special?

Its twin-heart design, 24K gold tone plated finish, skin-friendly feel, and 24K gold tone plated VELORE Snake Chain make it stylish, elegant, and easy to wear.
